answer: The nebula is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the forge. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, released only after three unrelated confirmations. What survives to the willow is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
